description: Implementation of CustomerOptionSetDao for database operations related to CustomerOptionSet entities, including methods for retrieving by ID, option ID, option value ID, and listing by store with localization support.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionSet entity, providing database access methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its ID, fetching associated options and values.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet by a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet by a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists CustomerOptionSet for a store with localization, ordered by sort order.
